listed.name: Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.Primitives.PivotHeaderItem
listed.reason: covered by Pivot: WinUI makes it only inside a Pivot, as the header of a PivotItem (constructing it fails with E_NOINTERFACE), so a header is styled with the `header` snippet of PivotItem

listed.name: Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.SwapChainBackgroundPanel
listed.reason: the UWP panel WinUI 3 keeps for compatibility, bound and mounted: it refuses Opacity, Width, Height, MinWidth, MaxWidth, MinHeight, MaxHeight and Margin (0x80004005) and is allowed only as the application's root visual or inside a Page, so it cannot be placed in a panel like every other component; SwapChainPanel is its replacement
